pix.definition:
n a chest in which coins from the mint are held to await assay
n any receptacle in which wafers for the Eucharist are kept

pix betulae liquida.translation: [医] 白桦焦油, 洋桦沥青

pixar.translation: n. 皮克斯；皮克斯动画工作室

pixe.translation: [化] 质子激发X射线发射分析

pixel.definition: n. (computer science) the smallest discrete component of an image or picture on a CRT screen (usually a colored dot)

pixel counting.definition:
The act of staring at one's screen to avoid bullshit at work. 
> Yea I missed the big catastrophe at work today as I was too busy pixel counting.

pixelate.translation: v. 使像素化; 打上马赛克

pixelated.translation: n. 像素化；视频滤镜效果

pixels.definition: n (computer science) the smallest discrete component of an image or picture on a CRT screen (usually a colored dot)
pixels.translation: n. 像素；像素点（pixel的复数）

pixie.definition:
n (folklore) fairies that are somewhat mischievous
n creeping evergreen shrub having narrow overlapping leaves and early white star-shaped flowers; of the pine barrens of New Jersey and the Carolinas
pixie.translation:

a. 淘气的, 调皮捣蛋的, 恶作剧的

pixies.translation: n. 小精灵, 小仙子( pixie的名词复数 )

pixilated.definition:
s naughtily or annoyingly playful
s very drunk
